programme_status: candidate mechanism; no historic breakthrough established

claims.title: Constructive positive recursion and source-word approximation
claims.statement: For a>0, Phi(X)=sum V_i X V_i* with sum V_i V_i*<=I, and P=BB*, F(X)=g_a(Phi(X)+P) has a unique positive fixed point. X_0=0 gives 0<=X*-X_k<=I/[a(k+1)]. Positive subsolutions A satisfy A<=X*. Finite source rank implies ran X_k lies in source words of length <k.
claims.cost: O(1/(a epsilon)) steps; generated-space dimensions, application, acquisition, Gram conditioning and precision remain charged. No polynomial-in-input-bitlength claim for implicit infinite operators.
claims.sharpness: Harmonic shift fixed point has exact truncation error 1/(k+2) at a=b=1.

claims.title: Exact reciprocal-window minimum source rank
claims.statement: For compact positive singular-square list lambda_j with a lambda_1<1, permitting arbitrary kernel enlargement, minimum rank B across T realizing the list under T*T<=g_a(TT*+BB*) equals sup_x #{j:x<=1/lambda_j<x+a}.
claims.construction: r-step forward weighted shift and root source f_a(lambda_j).
claims.limits: Preserves singular values, not general eigenvalues, locality, original polar factor, or fixed ambient dimension.

claims.title: Optimal source-to-spectrum summability law
claims.statement: Under T*T<=g_a(TT*+BB*), B in S_p implies T in S_max(p+2,2p). For p<=2, ||T||_(p+2)^(p+2)<=2||B||_p^p/(pa); for p>=2, ||T||_(2p)^4<=||B||_p^2/a.
claims.sharpness: Diagonal normal examples force 2p; sums of harmonic weighted shifts force p+2. Constants are sharp.
claims.limits: Not transferable to arbitrary multi-channel row recursions.

claims.title: Multiplicity obstruction and explicit row-shift replacement
claims.statement: For A e_alpha=(|alpha|+2)^-1 e_alpha, a=1, cutoff degree m in n variables requires scalar source rank binomial(n+m-1,m). Full n>=2 requires infinite scalar source rank. Standard symmetric row shifts realize A with one vacuum source and n channels, but generated dimensions remain binomial(n+k-1,n).
claims.limits: Known shift objects; no algorithmic advantage over diagonal baseline; free-word example is compact but belongs to no finite Schatten class.

claims.title: Sharp essential-norm floor for additive curvature residual
claims.statement: If T*T<=g_a(TT*+BB*)+epsilon I and B compact, then ||T||_ess^2<=(epsilon+sqrt(epsilon^2+4epsilon/a))/2.
claims.sharpness: Scalar identity block with B=0 attains equality.
claims.limits: Any nonzero residual fails to certify compactness; finite-dimensional identity blocks can have arbitrary multiplicity.
